newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian trade minister loses women's party post.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian trade minister loses women's party post.

text.p: Malaysia's International Trade and Industry Minister Rafidah Aziz on Wednesday narrowly lost the chairmanship of the women's wing of Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad's political party, officials said.

Rafidah, a former economics professor who had headed the women's wing of the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO) for the past decade, lost to Deputy Health Minister Siti Zaharah Sulaiman 271 to 244.
Rafidah, an articulate and outspoken representative of Malaysia in international trade arenas, was challenged for the first time since taking over as head of the women's wing in 1984.
Elections for the chairman of UMNO's youth wing were to be announced on Wednesday as well. Polls for other top positions in the party will take place on Thursday.
